## Methods

The counts of 8 categories of cell_type were summed within each of 12 samples (sample) and converted to proportions of the sample total. The samples fall into 2 groups (control: n = 6, treated: n = 6). For each category, the per-sample proportions were compared between the groups with the Mann-Whitney U test (two-sided, with the exact null distribution when there are fewer than 50 samples per group and no ties), and the P values were adjusted across the 8 categories with the Benjamini-Hochberg method; 3 categories had an adjusted P below 0.05. Proportions are compositional: they sum to one within each sample, so a rise in one category forces the others down and the per-category tests are not independent. The tests are therefore exploratory; a compositional method, for example a log-ratio transform, is needed for a confirmatory claim. Computed in R 4.4.1 and drawn with ggplot2 3.5.1.
